name: go-toolchain
label: Go toolchain
description: The go tool, as a build check, a vet check, a test check and a command. Each tool takes the package pattern as a variable, so a large module can be checked one directory at a time.

tools.label: go build
tools.description: Compiles the selected packages and reports the compiler's file:line: message diagnostics.

variables.name: packages
variables.label: Package pattern (the argument go build receives)

tools.label: go vet
tools.description: Runs the vet analysers over the selected packages; its findings share the compiler's diagnostic format.

variables.name: packages
variables.label: Package pattern (the argument go vet receives)

tools.label: go test
tools.description: Runs the selected packages' tests with -json and reports each failure from that event stream.

variables.name: packages
variables.label: Package pattern (the argument go test receives)

tools.label: go
tools.description: The go CLI itself, so a model can run a one-off subcommand (go env, go list) through run_command.
